protocol.purpose: One bounded batch: adapt five methods to closed H1 candles to test whether larger price distances survive unchanged cash costs, plus one subsequent-confirmation hypothesis for G2 and G4. This changes timeframe, context and holding limits together; it is not an isolated causal attribution to any one change.
protocol.source: Existing Five Percent Online XAUUSD H1 and H4 exports from 2026-09-10, verified against their original SHA256 manifest; no live account queries or orders.
protocol.chronologyCaveat: 2016-2021 is held out of parameter selection in this batch, but prior research outside this batch cannot be excluded. 2022 onward informed earlier research and the diagnosis motivating this batch. Nothing here is a prospective or untouched-data claim. Warm-up data from 2009 and earlier H4 are indicator context only.
protocol.selection: Seven fixed configurations, five families. One control each and one extra confirmation configuration for G2/G4. Rank only within family on continuous development stress net / conservativeDrawdown; zero DD ineligible. Both base and stress must have >=100 trades, net>0, PF>=1.10, no unpriced overnight and no account breach. Select highest eligible, otherwise highest failed for diagnosis only. Freeze selection and hashes before reading evaluation performance. Failed development candidates are not evaluated on validation or retrospectiveReserve; knownRecent/knownTrailing may be reported descriptively but cannot rescue them. No new variants or parameter changes within this batch.
protocol.historicalScreen: Development eligible; each of validation, retrospectiveReserve, knownRecent and knownTrailing has >=100 base trades, net>0, PF>=1.20, conservativeDrawdown<=8000 and conservativeDailyLoss<=2000; corresponding stress net>0, conservativeDrawdown<=10000 and conservativeDailyLoss<=3000; neither scenario has account breach or unpriced overnight. Screen alone is not operational approval. Family versions do not count as additional strategies.
protocol.riskReference: Summer 2-Step: max(previous available broker-day closing balance, mark-to-market equity). Daily permitted loss is min(3000, 0.03*reference), retaining the user's absolute cap. Reaching either daily floor or fixed total floor 90000 permanently disqualifies that simulation account. Conservative OHLC intrabar estimates are flagged separately, without fabricated fills at a risk floor. No deposits/restarts within a trajectory.
protocol.costCaveat: Fixed scenarios, not certified executable historical costs. Candle minimum spread is never used to price its own open. No zero-swap assumption: an unexpected overnight position disqualifies the screen.
protocol.common: Closed H1 decision, next contiguous same-day H1 open; entries 08:00<=broker hour<20:00. Stop/target observed conservatively, stop first if both touched. Exit at 20:00 observed open, or first subsequent open if missing. Default hold8 H1 bars (G3 hold6), max2 entries/day (G2 max1). ATR14 Wilder, signal stop distance1..3ATR and recheck actual entry, buffer0.25ATR, target>=1R. Full fixed250 risk headroom required. Tick0.01, min/step0.01lot, max100lots,100oz/lot,notional<=10xequity. No timestamp conversion to London/NewYork.

families.name: Pullback de tendência H1
families.rule: H4 completed close andEMA50 aboveEMA200, EMA50 rising3 completed bars (symmetric for short). H1 close recrosses EMA20 and bullish; stop minimum of two candles minus0.25ATR,2R. H4 nominal close must be <=H1 signal close and no more than4h old.

families.name: Faixa inicial e reteste H1
families.rule: Complete contiguous range08:00-10:00. First closed breakout with previous close inside and close beyond edge+0.1ATR arms the day, signal bar opening>=10:00; both versions entry<14:00. Control signals on breakout. Confirmation waits only next2 contiguous same-day bars; for long require low within +/-0.25 frozen breakoutATR of range high, close above edge and bullish; cancel on close<=edge, gap or expiry. Short symmetric. Frozen midpoint stop,2R; one opportunity/day, even if execution declines it.

families.name: Retorno às Bandas H1
families.rule: H4 completed EMA50 slope over3bars has absolute value<=0.25ATR_H4, context <=4h old. H1 previous close outside SMA20+/-2.5 population SD, current close inside and reversal-colored candle. Stop extreme of2candles +/-0.25ATR; fixed SMA20 target atsignal,>=1R; hold6bars.

families.name: Varredura e confirmação H1
families.rule: Prior traded day exactly23 contiguous H1bars starting00:00or01:00. Rejection beyond prior low/high by0.1..1ATR, closes back inside and reversal-colored candle. First rejection of each edge/day arms that edge; control signals there. Confirmation waits next2 contiguous same-day bars for close beyond the opposite extreme of rejection candle; cancel on breach of rejection extreme, gap, expiry. Stop rejection extreme +/-0.25 frozen rejectionATR;2R.

families.name: Divergência RSI H1
families.rule: Strict pivots3bars eachside learned at rightmost close only. Lasttwo same-direction pivots6..40bars apart: price lowerlow/higherhigh>=0.1ATR atnewpivot, RSI14 divergence>=5points and RSI<45 long/>55 short; confirmation candle bullish/bearish. Stop pivot extreme +/-0.25 currentATR,2R. No retroactive signal.

remainingBeforeOperation: Broker executable spread/commission and timezone verification
